extensions.source: DESIGN.md describes the approved product system. app/src/ui/tokens.css owns values. Examples use semantic tokens rather than an independently copied palette.

motion.name: dur-slow
motion.purpose: Sheet state changes, bypassed when keyboard focus needs immediate visibility.

surfaces.name: Ambient kiosk
surfaces.behavior: Useful public overview; scanning never takes over its content.

surfaces.name: Presented kiosk
surfaces.behavior: Explicit public target, acknowledged render, confirmed takeover and return to overview.

surfaces.name: Personal view
surfaces.behavior: Private browsing, six domains, one consistently placed presentation control.

surfaces.name: Safety
surfaces.behavior: Public, unlimited and server rendered without JavaScript.

components.name: Route badge
components.description: Static signage, not an inflated button. A rectangle denotes tram, a capsule denotes bus.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: 48px touch target, clear action and state. Success is not shown before screen acknowledgement.
